title: ixeris brachyrhyncha
intro: Ixeris brachyrhyncha, commonly known as Korean liquorice, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, improve digestion, and alleviate stress. The bioactive constituents of Ixeris brachyrhyncha include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
